notes.title: CHALLENGE MAP 2 RELEASED NOW
notes.content:
[h1]Rocky road here[/h1]

As you all know the path here has been rocky with the game files getting corrupted and tons of other work outside of this game so this update is long overdue but its finally here!

[h2]Challenge Level 2[/h2]

[h3]Lore[/h3]
Challenge Level 2 takes place in the City of Batou in China.
This High-rise environment houses some of the wealthiest and greatest people in all of china all the way from the great street merchants to the wealthy venture capitalists this city unites the people of the nation.

Mr. Mega is here to uncover information about a top secret missile project orchestrated by the HOLYSNAKE to get an edge in the Battle of Eternal Control.

[h2]New Mechanics[/h2]

[h3]Blue Field[/h3]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/o9xaobW.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/o9xaobW.png[/img][/url]

As you all know, hitting walls in MEGAJUMP decreases your speed.
However, if you hit a wall inside of a Blue Field you Gain speed. Think of it as a Speed boost bounce.

Just remember to not hold any direction when charging up a Speed Bounce Jump inside of the Aura

[h3]Yellow Field[/h3]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/HJ8disQ.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/HJ8disQ.png[/img][/url]

This is a very special Field. Whenever you enter a yellow field the your upwards momentum will exponentially increase causing you to gain more and more upwards speed the longer you are inside of the Yellow Field. You can make some very interesting plays with this!

[h3]Glowing Pink[/h3]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/Icm4V8L.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/Icm4V8L.png[/img][/url]

Any glowing platform colored pink will reset your vertical momentum meaning that if you are falling really fast the Glowing Pink platform will make it so you fall with initial gravity instead. Same goes for upwards momentum. This is mostly used to make certain parts more consistent.

[h2]New Song![/h2]

For this map we got the Epic musician CPHMANIA to create a song. This song is actually slapping hardcore. 
Make sure to check him out on Youtube and Spotify as DJ FGT (DJ Fortnite Gamer Twitch)
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXRiQCiY40iL_gZpdH9tc5Q

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

We made some changes to the "Walking off platform" mechanic. Now your speed when walking off the platform will always be half of the maximum forward speed when jumping meaning that the speed will be more consistent.

notes.title: 09/10-2021 MAJOR BUG FIXED - Performance improvement
notes.content:
[h1]Major bugfix[/h1]

There was a bug in the games programming where it would create a sound file every frame the game was running which caused the sound engine to use more and more of the machines resources until it crashed and the sound would stop. This also caused the game to use a lot more of the RAM and CPU than required.

I have now fixed this issue so performance should be better than before and the sound should not stop after about 30 minutes of gameplay anymore.

Thanks for the patience.

notes.title: October 4th 2021 Patch notes
notes.content:
We found a bug with the Leaderboard Scoring where it would only publish your Leaderboard Scores if you got a time better than the achievement limit but this has now been changed so whenever you beat a time trial map your time will automatically be uploaded to the Global Steam Leaderboards.

Also changed some of the back end files so performance should be a bit better on lower end systems.

Again, Thank you all for playing the game. We really hope you are enjoying the game and we are happy to announce that Challenge Level 2 is in full development.

notes.title: Global Time Trial Leaderboards!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow Jumpers![/h1]

We are happy to announce that [h3]Global Steam leaderboards[/h3] for the Time Trial modes are now visible on the Community tab.
Whenever you complete any Time Trial level under 60 minutes it records your score and uploads it to the Steam Leaderboards so that you can always see who has the best time and which time you need to beat!

Currently there is only one person with a time on the Leaderboards so there is plenty of space to try and take the Speedrun Records for each level.

To get to the Leaderboards you need to navigate to the community hub and press the "View Stats" button as shown in the image below. Here you can navigate through all the different Time trial Leaderboards.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/JbS0na4.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/JbS0na4.png[/img][/url]


As the rest of the Challenge levels are added to the game the Leaderboards will be active.
We can already inform that Challenge Level 2 is in works so you can look forward to that. We will make an announcement when it is released so that all Jumpers have a chance of getting the World Record.

There is also a leaderboard on the Speedrun.com website dedicated for MEGAJUMP so if you are a streamer or speedrunner you can always submit your runs there as well for a more curated list. This is very helpful when it comes to developing new strats or to learn strats from other people.

Click the image to go to the Speedrun.com page.
[url=https://www.speedrun.com/megajump][img]https://i.imgur.com/eljrqSV.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: MEGAJUMP SEASON 2 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]HERE WE GO![/h1]

Friday is a huge day. After 4 over months of development SEASON 2 of MEGAJUMP will release + an all new Time Trial mode unlocked after beating the game once.
Not only that, the graphics engine has been completely overhauled to better represent the modern aesthetic of Mega Jumping

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
We have completely rebuilt the entire map from the ground up with PBR textures and new Geometry.
There is also an Overworld which can be accessed by using a secret teleporter somewhere on the map.

[h1]Time Trial Mode[/h1]
Once you beat the game once (or change the save file) you unlock the brand new Time Trial mode where you get to race against your friends in trying to beat the game with the fastest time possible. Your best time gets submitted to a Global steam leaderboard in milliseconds so people can much easier check who has the best time.

In time trial mode you can pause the game at any time and restart the level from the start without having to manually walk back to the start.

At Launch the Time Trial launches with 3 maps
[list]
[*] Pit of Despair 
[*] The Bog
[*] Challenge Level 1
[/list]

Pit of Despair is the normal map you all know and love but with some minor changes closing off areas like the Bog.

The Bog is the Bog Level plus the Pit of Despair levels combined into one.

Challenge Level 1 is a completely new map with new mechanics to figure out. I hope you all enjoy the new map as we have spent quite some time developing it.

[h3]Time Trial Challenge Pack[/h3]
As an added bonus to the Season 2 Release there will be a total of 2 more challenge levels released for the time trial mode as time progresses. These levels have yet to be developed but will come as free content updates in due time.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/Fhk7ONs.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/Fhk7ONs.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
There are a bunch of new achievements for the game to collect and figure out. Some are easier than others.
There are two new NPC characters added to the Pit of Despair which can be found in normal play mode. Can you find them both?

I hope you all enjoy this update and have a good time playing it!
